reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 26505955 (hash 0xa50e54c6703eaed980d65280d5d8eb0d0bda24f104ed8f48d94814aafedd0767, 2026-11-27T10:30:47Z), tBRL totalSupply was 2,604,641.380283959 tBRL (~$461,425 USD at DefiLlama's $0.17715482 quote, or ~$461,134 USD at Chainlink BRL/USD $0.177043). The deployed tBRL Morpho V2 Vault (0xe275a69b93a5745e1560ee82d033205d323bfad9, Steakhouse USDC adapter) held totalAssets() = 355,144.70 USDC (an on-chain liability-coverage ratio of ~77.0% of tBRL value), while CollateralManager (0x67eb9338bad71443adc1f6c319d5400292a8b7e4) held 0 idle USDC and Controller.ratio() was set to 0.15 (15% routed to CustodianModule for off-chain hedging). Separately, at finalized Base block 62923312, Chainlink's Tenbin Aggregated Off-Chain Reserves feed (0x7b1c8c60c05913af3aa21bae3b32a02ab4f39bd3) reported $291,208.36 (updated 2026-11-27T10:06:07Z) across all Tenbin assets combined at Ripple Prime, combining USD cash, USDC, and unrealized futures P&L. Because per-token off-chain asset totals are not segregated across tGLD, tMXN, and tBRL, neither tBRL's total reserves nor its off-chain share is established; whole-book reserve weights are therefore withheld as a single 100% unclassified residual pending per-token reserve totals.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer collateral architecture and pinned Ethereum Morpho V2 Vault totalAssets() at block 26505955 (355,144.70 USDC, ~77.0% liability coverage); whole-book reserve denominator unobserved because off-chain Chainlink PoR is aggregated across products
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Whole-book reserve weights are withheld because Tenbin reports off-chain reserves at Ripple Prime and undisclosed FCM clearing accounts (combining USD cash, USDC, and unrealized CME futures P&L) only as one combined cross-product Chainlink PoR figure ($291,208.36 across tGLD, tMXN, and tBRL). Pinned on-chain Morpho V2 USDC (355,144.70 USDC) equals ~77.0% of tBRL liabilities, not a whole-book reserve weight.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Tenbin's documentation describes BVI segregated-portfolio statutory asset segregation under Tenbin AssetCo (BVI) SPC Ltd. and a bankruptcy-remote structure, but no independent legal opinion is published and the Terms of Use classify each token as an unsecured debt obligation. On-chain USDC is lent via the Steakhouse USDC Morpho V2 vault and off-chain collateral margins CME futures at Ripple Prime and undisclosed FCM partners, so rehypothecation/deployment of collateral is permitted and per-asset off-chain custody shares remain unverified.
